title: act.result
description: Outcome of an act.* request; MG2: also of region.park, region.resume and region.start (kind park|resume|start; detail new|continue for a start); MG5: the server's answer to party.stash (kind stash, moved) travels S→C. MG6: the answer to bag.set (kind bag.set, left: what did not fit) is forwarded C→S by the client. FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.4: the server's refusal of a party.item (kind item, ok false, reason unknown_uid, no_slot, move_known, no_evolution, max_level, no_effect, unsupported, its id) travels S→C and the client relays it to the link that sent the item (M→G).

kind.description: What was done: an interact kind (npc, sign, ...), park, resume, start, stash, bag.set, item (FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.4; MG6: a dotted kind names the request type it answers).

detail.description: What the act did, when the kind has variants: a region.start's "new" or "continue".

moved.description: MG5, kind stash: how many party members went into the PC.

left.description: MG6, kind bag.set: the items and quantities the bag could not hold (they stay in the ledger: "in your trunk").

id.description: Kind item: the party.item's id this answers.
